units.source_text: 真砂子也抬头望了望杉山。

en.t: Masako also lifted her head and looked at the cedar-covered mountain.

units.source_text: 笔直耸立的一排排树干，实在美极了。

en.t: The rows of trunks rising straight upward were truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 残留在树梢顶端的一簇簇叶子，也像是精巧的工艺品。

en.t: The clusters of leaves left at the very tops of the trees also looked like delicate works of craft.
